decision_summary: Proceed with QIF v0.6.5 Trace Approval Evidence.
rationale: Current agent tooling trends emphasize MCP approvals, tracing, resumable runs, and prompt-injection boundaries; QIF should make approval evidence structurally auditable before broader hook/CLI work.
recommendation: Release v0.6.5 after npm test and repository hygiene checks pass.
target_audience: QIF maintainers and AI agents using Action Quality Contract
expected_user_reaction: They can see which approval evidence justified an accepted tool action.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add traceApprovalEvidence to action-quality-contract schema, example, verifier, fixtures, docs, and release notes.
organization_change_recommendations: Keep verifier boundary explicit: structural approval traceability is not semantic tool safety.
